Beautiful Trails. I love the views and the trail conditions are usually pretty good! However, it’s disappointing how many people are letting their dogs crap all over the trail and then leaving it. Also, lots of people with their dogs off-leash. I’ve had dogs jump all over me and even got lightly bit on the arm last week. I love dogs, but if someone was afraid of them these trails could be a nightmare. It’s especially difficult as a trail runner, because dogs like to chase after you. Please clean-up after and control your pets.

I did a trail run. Trails were mostly frozen, so mud wasn’t a major problem. Just need to be aware of sections that got roughed up a lot when it was muddy, and they’ve now frozen. You could easily role an ankle if you’re not careful. Was a beautiful run though!

Stay on trails! Don’t go on overgrown side trails! Our dog went 2-3 feet on a side trail near the end of this loop, it was a trail with lots of logs. He had 7 ticks on him we removed ASAP after we actually did see tick on the path! Beautiful trail, moderate hills great for mountain biking. All signage warns of ticks at trail head, believe them and take precautions. Washrooms are locked Trail parking was open however small and busy on the weekend. We will not be back.

My wife and kids (4 &5 years old) hiked this trail on a beautiful Sunday afternoon. the trail is easy/moderate with some small inclines and mostly dirt pathway through forestry. You cross several bridges during the loop. The trail is very friendly for dogs however trail rules state they must be kept on leash. Generally just maintaining control of your dog is the expectation here; so just use your discretion. Overall it's a very nice trail with plenty to explore and lots of wild life. We even encountered a small snake just off the path! Enjoy on a dry day for less mud! Highly recommended though.
